head: 6882c975ad38080d9c11deb69217989f5ea1a739
reason: Both cases pass every review dimension. (1) Ground truth: both bases are runtime_proof and both runtime/check.php scripts exit 0 when executed (PHP 8.3.35). Case 1's script independently verifies the disjoint Dog::bark/Cat::meow member sets, that Box<Dog>::get() dispatches to Dog and Box<Cat>::get() to Cat (so the substituted type is the class the annotation names, not mixed), and that get()->bark() on Box<Cat> throws 'Error: Call to undefined method ...Cat::bark()'. Case 2's script verifies Cat is not a Dog, a fresh Bag<Dog> reads back a Dog, put_cat() writes a Cat through the widened Bag<Animal> view, and adopt() fails on its native Dog return type ('Return value must be of type Dog, Cat returned') - the declared covariance plus write position is unsound, not merely unidiomatic. Citations are relevant to the runtime failures described. (2) Expectations: every predicate is specific (code + line, plus message_regex pinning the substituted class 'Cat' on required predicates); no empty predicates; neither case uses 'allowed', so nothing was acknowledged away or widened, and the asymmetric controls (case 1: lines 41 and 53; case 2: line 51) are forbidden and verified silent. (3) Verdicts reproduced: python3 harness/bench.py run --case <id> executed for both cases; runtime checks passed 1/1; report.json shows all three tools verdict=ok with no missing/unexpected/acknowledged. Raw output matches the files' claims exactly - case 1: phpstan method.notFound line 47 ('Cat::bark'), psalm UndefinedMethod line 47, mago non-existent-method line 47 ('bark ... Cat'); case 2: phpstan generics.variance line 30, psalm InvalidTemplateParam line 29, mago invalid-template-parameter line 30, all messages containing 'covariant', matching the tool_pins and code/line split asserted in notes. (4) Contract: python3 harness/bench.py validate reports 30 cases checked, 0 invalid; composer.json present in both cases; git ls-tree of the head commit shows exactly the five allowed files per case - no vendor/, .generated/, scratch or results committed (harness-generated vendor/ is gitignored, cases/**/vendor/). (5) Novelty: corpus-wide rule_class inventory shows 'undefined-method' and 'template-variance-violation' are unique to these two cases; the only other variance-adjacent case (assignability/docblock-return-covariance, rule_class method.childReturnType) tests override return-type widening, a different semantic criterion. The four template-related factory/catalog.json leads (SKIPPED-noCrashOnInvalidClassTemplateAsType, array-shape-template-key, assert-argless-call-template-default, template-bounds) cover different rules, so the notes' decision to record no source_candidate_id is correct. All four provenance source files exist in the Mago checkout at the pinned revision and their description in the notes is accurate (sound covariant-only-read fixture; scalar-consumption invalid-argument fixture; mirror-image contravariant declaration; invalid-template-parameter appears only in @extends/@implements/@use fixtures; no suite fixture expects non-existent-method from a substitution). No unsupported claims found.
